event.title: Message containing personal data
event.description: The citizen includes identifiers in the question. Deterministic masking replaces each item with a token before any processing; only types and counts are traced.

responses.message:
As a precaution, I masked the personal data in your message (numbers, email addresses): it is neither stored nor transmitted. Please avoid sharing it here.

In non-agricultural public or private establishments, the legal working time cannot exceed forty hours per week [1].

In agricultural or similar enterprises, the limit is set at 2400 hours per year, with a maximum of forty-eight hours per week [1].

These rules apply to all workers, regardless of age, gender, or method of payment [1]. If your employer asks you to work beyond these limits, please note that specific decrees may authorize exceptions and define how overtime is calculated and paid [1]. You should check your employment contract or collective agreement to see if any specific arrangements apply to your situation.
